historicalIdentity.digestPreimage: ASCII PoolActionFv1/TxContext concatenated directly with the complete canonical TxContextFv1 preimage
historicalIdentity.identityRule: The preimage, digest domain, codec version, and historical inclusion boundary must remain unchanged.

excluded: Circle-FRI proof bytes and proof-carrier unlocking wrappers
the transaction ID of the transaction being constructed
included: transactionVersion, locktime, exact inputCount, and exact outputCount
every input wire index, role tag, role ordinal, outpoint, sequence, source value, complete source locking bytecode, and complete source token record
every output wire index, role tag, role ordinal, value, complete locking bytecode, and complete token record

nonClaims: No digest function, introspection adapter, deployment token-kind, or concrete transaction is selected or executed here.
No historical TxContextFv1 byte, domain, version, or inclusion-boundary change is authorized.
No authenticated context-digest closure, proof acceptance, qualification, or measurement admission is claimed.

requiredPipeline: read and range-check transactionVersion, locktime, exact inputCount, and exact outputCount
introspect every input and output in wire order, including full source/output locks, values, indices, roles, ordinals, and token projections
construct one canonical TxContextFv1 preimage with codecVersion 1 and fully parse it with no suffix, truncation, duplicate, skipped, or independently supplied field
recompute the configured 32-byte ContextDigest over the unchanged domain concatenated with the canonical preimage
compare the result to PAST transactionContextDigest and byte-compare every duplicated statement/context/deployment field
reject injected facts.contextDigest, adapter callbacks that return an authoritative digest, and any second digest source

tokenProjectionBridge.finding: The available introspection token-kind projection is non-injective for fungible-only versus immutable NFT with an empty commitment.
tokenProjectionBridge.requiredDisposition: The exact deployment manifest must fix every carrier tokenKind and the adapter must prove a total, deployment-static mapping from introspection fields to that exact token record before canonical TxContextFv1 encoding.
tokenProjectionBridge.simplestCandidate: all carrier tokenKind values are none
tokenProjectionBridge.versionWarning: Narrowing the universal P0 token language, rather than selecting an already-permitted concrete deployment, triggers the Fv2 kill condition unless separately authorized as an explicit additive P0 revision.

requiredSingleInvariantFalsifiers: replace the recomputed digest with an injected 32-byte fact
append one byte to an otherwise valid TxContextFv1 preimage
alter one included transaction field while retaining the old digest
swap one direct PAST projection while retaining the canonical context
confuse fungible-only with immutable-empty-NFT under the deployment token-kind bridge
substitute a carrier tokenKind differing from its exact deployment manifest entry
